## Summary

## Type of change

- [ ] Documentation update (existing document)
- [ ] New document or file
- [ ] Schema change

## Checklist

- [ ] Changes are limited to what the linked issue describes.
- [ ] No production code, credentials, or personal data is included.
- [ ] Historical records are appended, not overwritten.
- [ ] If a new ADR is required, it has been added to `docs/decisions/` and the index in `docs/decisions/README.md` is updated.
- [ ] If agent charters or prompts changed, the relevant OUTPUT_SCHEMA.md is consistent with the change.
- [ ] The PR description explains the reason for the change.
